name: Wave of Pain
body:
School necromancy [pain]; Level bard 6, inquisitor 6, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, M (a platinum needle worth 50 gp)

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.

Area cone
Duration 1 round/2 levels
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

All living creatures within the cone are overcome with intense pain. They are stunned for the duration of the spell unless they succeed at a Fortitude save. Creatures with resistance or immunity against precision damage and critical hits or has been healed in the round prior to the saving throw gains a +4 bonus on the save against this spell. Each round, at the end of its turns, a subject of the spell can attempt a new save to end the effect.
